newsitem.title: USA: Alumax Extrusions to boost prices $0.03/lb.
newsitem.headline: Alumax Extrusions to boost prices $0.03/lb.

text.p: Alumax Extrusions Inc, a subsidiary of Alumax Inc, said Thursday it would raise prices for its Alumax Transportation Products business unit $0.03 a pound for all extruded products, effective immediately.
Alumax Extrusions in Cressona, Pa., makes soft alloy aluminum extrusions.
The company is comprised of three separate business units -- Alumax Transportation Products, Cressona Aluminum Co and Alumax Building & Construction Products.
